## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run lint` and `npm run typecheck` are clean
- [ ] `npm run check:links` passes — every sidebar entry has a page, every page
      is linked, every internal link resolves
- [ ] `npm run check:snippets` passes if I touched a Go sample marked `verify`
- [ ] `npm run build` succeeds
- [ ] I edited `src/content/**/*.mdx`, **not** `public/md/**` — the latter is
      generated by `prebuild` and my edit would vanish at the next build

## If I added a page

- [ ] Added to the relevant file in `src/sidebars/`
- [ ] Frontmatter has a `title`
- [ ] Follows the template for its track — Learn: `<Intro>` → `<YouWillLearn>` →
      narrative → `<Recap>` → `<Challenges>`; Reference: `<Intro>` →
      `<Signature>`/`<Parameters>`/`<Returns>`/`<Caveats>` → `<Recipe>` →
      `<Trouble>`

## If I added a table or a diagram

- [ ] Tables render from `src/data/` through `data-views.tsx` rather than being
      hand-written — a hand-written grid drifts from every other copy of the
      same fact
- [ ] Diagrams use the components in `components/mdx/diagram.tsx`, not mermaid.
      Mermaid belongs in the two GitHub-only repositories; here a figure must
      inherit the page theme

## Accuracy

- [ ] Nothing here claims the library does something it does not
- [ ] If a provider silently ignores a feature I documented, the page says so

<!-- Honesty over coverage. The ⚠️ column in the feature matrix is the most
     useful thing on the site precisely because nothing else publishes it. -->
